## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is a loud and reckless individual who frequently gets sunburned. In addition to her boisterous nature, she possesses the practical skills necessary to keep house.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P7](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0007)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton frightened [Dora](../character/dora.md) at school with stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chose to go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons) instead of attending [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) as instructed.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

[Tommy](../character/tommy.md) is the brother of Mirabel Cotton. He is part of the Cotton family, whom [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to join for a fishing outing instead of attending [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), +2 more_
